description: SpaceToggle OS default capabilities — settings window AND the HUD overlay. The overlay MUST be listed here: without it the overlay webview has no core:event permission, listen() rejects silently, and the HUD renders as an empty dark box (root cause found 2026-08-10 after chasing emit targets, paint order and CSP). PROBLEM 164: shell:allow-execute was removed 2026-08-20 — it grants the webview arbitrary process execution and had no caller; every shell-out here is a Rust command instead. Do not re-add it without one.
